scores.scale: 0 unusable; 2 severe barriers; 5 mixed and materially frustrating; 7 good with noticeable friction; 9 excellent with minor issues; 10 exceptional within assessed scope. Holistic judgement, not a win-rate or arithmetic score.

controls.reasons: Large separated buttons, successful tap-to-aim and simultaneous route/fire. HOLD ROUTE made the mission accessible in portrait. Recovery re-press behavior and aiming versus rear threats create friction. Manual stick, look drag, AIM, dash, jump and tools not tested.

gameplay.reasons: Observed loop has clear escalating goals: recover three people, disable three timed coils, return and upload. Short bursts rewarded learning. Assisted travel reduces navigation burden but much of observed play became holding a button, and offscreen pressure competes with coil attention. No assessment of optional combat depth or unseen content.

presentation.reasons: Cohesive dark teal industrial scene, strong title typography, copper coils and cyan progress accents, readable terminal hierarchy. Some dark silhouettes merge into the scene. Audio unassessed.

usability.reasons: Useful in-game handbook, explicit objective strip, paused map with route, visible fresh reset and honest assist statistics. Recovery mode switching needs attentive release timing. No settings changes or alternate systems assessed.

readability.reasons: Health, ammunition, objectives and major buttons legible at 390x844; detailed terminal statistics and map legend are small and tracked. Narrow scene makes rear threats rely heavily on directional text.

scores.holisticReason: Good assisted mobile mission flow with useful guidance and strong visual identity; portrait attention management, recovery hold semantics and small secondary text prevent a higher grade. Two wins do not by themselves establish quality or sustained enjoyment.
